subject.title: Feature: Support custom anthropic_beta flags in Bedrock model config

question: Should Bedrock expose a broad `additionalModelRequestFields` or `providerFields` passthrough, a narrower typed `anthropicBeta` or `context1m` option, or no user-configurable beta flags?
rationale: The source gap is clear, but the fix adds a user-facing provider config contract and repository policy treats provider routing and config/default surfaces as compatibility-sensitive product decisions.

options.title: Add Bedrock-owned request fields
options.body: Expose a Bedrock plugin or per-model params contract that safely merges request fields, validates shape, documents upgrade behavior, and covers `anthropic_beta` without changing core generic config.

options.title: Add only a narrow beta flag
options.body: Support a typed Bedrock `anthropicBeta` or `context1m` path for Claude long context while avoiding a general Converse body passthrough.

options.title: Decline custom betas
options.body: Keep Bedrock request shaping internal and require first-class provider support for each beta feature as it becomes necessary.

recommendation.title: Add Bedrock-owned request fields
recommendation.body: Expose a Bedrock plugin or per-model params contract that safely merges request fields, validates shape, documents upgrade behavior, and covers `anthropic_beta` without changing core generic config.

likelyOwner.reason: The decision spans provider/plugin boundary and config contract policy, and this owner has recent history in the relevant Bedrock provider surface.
